event_path.caption: From T-4 to T the 10-year excess return path rises 0.217% in high-demand months and 0.142% in low-demand months; from T to T+5 it moves -0.042% and -0.058% (means, 95% bands, 1993-01 to 2024-09).

terciles.caption: Mean T-4 to T 10-year excess return: 0.214% in high-demand months vs 0.136% in low-demand months (high minus low +0.078%; bootstrap 95% intervals, 1993-01 to 2024-09).

capacity.caption: forecast-sized: net Sharpe 0.64 at $10M, halves at $1.22bn; calendar-only: net Sharpe 0.69 at $10M, halves at $1.33bn (square-root impact on dealer volume, 5% of ADV cap, 2001-08 to 2024-09).

extension_series.caption: Mean extension is 0.101 years in refunding months and 0.046 in the other months (127 and 254 months, 1993-01 to 2024-09).

curve_map.caption: Within a month, a bucket with 1 sd more predicted demand sees its yield fall +0.02bp more over T-4 to T (95% CI -0.22 to +0.26, 1848 bucket-months, month fixed effects, 1993-01 to 2024-09).

equity_curve.caption: Growth of 1 in excess of T-bills, net of costs: forecast-sized 1.89x (Sharpe 0.57); calendar-only 1.77x (Sharpe 0.63); Flow Clock book 2.92x (Sharpe 0.87); curve-allocated 1.89x (Sharpe 0.69) (1993-01 to 2024-09). Futures and same-day cash (2010-07 to 2024-09): calendar-only, ZN futures 1.43x (Sharpe 0.79); calendar-only, cash, same days 1.38x (Sharpe 0.71); supply leg, futures 1.12x (Sharpe 0.29); supply leg, cash, same days 1.35x (Sharpe 0.62).

auction_event_path.caption: From A-5 to A the excess return path moves -0.200% for auctions large vs recent ones and -0.067% for small ones; from A to A+5 it moves +0.263% and -0.002% (means, 95% bands clustered by week, 1993-01 to 2024-09).

trials.rule: count = total logged runs = rows of runs/trials.csv (never deleted); distinct variants = distinct config_hash, N of the headline Deflated Sharpe (CLAUDE.md section 15)

futures.status: computed from the derived tables outputs/tables/futures_*; raw Databento data stays in data/cache/; the committed tables hold no notional, raw volume or exact cap factor and round daily notionals to $1M (CLAUDE.md section 15, Phase 4b)

data.source: Databento GLBX.MDP3: statistics (settlement), ohlcv-1d (volume), definition (monthly snapshots)

alignment.note: lag k: corr(settlement change on t, -dy10 on t + k); k = 0 should dominate if ts_ref is the trade date

vs_cash_calendar_only.note: cash calendar_only (10-year par bond) is the full in-sample run sliced to the futures days; descriptive

vs_cash_supply_calendar.note: cash calendar supply leg is the full in-sample run sliced to the futures days; descriptive

before_costs_same_days.note: Phase 4c, descriptive (CLAUDE.md section 15): Sharpe of daily net excess + that day's cost / capital over the futures days; cash = the full in-sample run sliced, futures = sharpe_gross of the supply leg (costs netted by contract in the strategy)
